dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave spline on the trailing edge, transitioning from a sharp apex to a wide posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded-acute apex with a narrow pixel radius, forming the distal-most point of the dorsal silhouette.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree angular steepness relative to the longitudinal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.2:1 ratio of longitudinal base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, high-radius convex arc extending from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered rostrum with a linear decrease in thickness toward the distal tip.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Measurable obtuse angle at the indentation where the melon slope meets the dorsal rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan monochromatic texture with internal diffuse lighting and absence of organic skin patterns.
